description: This file defines the RuleTableConfigResolver class, which configures and manages the notification rule table, including fetching, editing, enabling/disabling, and deleting notification rules within the application.

classes.name: RuleTableConfigResolver
classes.description: A resolver class that configures the notification rule table, including fetching, editing, enabling/disabling, and deleting rules.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for NotificationRule.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Sets up action descriptors for table cells, such as toggle enable/disable and copy rule actions.

methods.name: editRule
methods.description: Opens a dialog to edit or copy a notification rule.

methods.name: notificationRuleDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog component for creating or editing a notification rule.

methods.name: toggleEnableMode
methods.description: Toggles the enabled state of a notification rule and updates it via the notification service.
